items.title: Storms and heavy rain destroy crops just before harvest
items.blurb: Farmers in Kailali, Bardiya, Salyan and Dang have suffered losses to paddy, fruit and vegetables, raising fears of lower yields and increasing demands for government relief.

items.title: At least five killed in Pokhara school bus crash
items.blurb: Four students and a parent who hitched a ride on the bus died after it plunged 150 to 200 metres down a slope. Rescue teams are searching for survivors.

items.title: Bagmati province seeks Rs1 billion for Bhotekoshi flood reconstruction
items.blurb: Province to provide Rs25 million to 12 affected local units as preliminary assessment puts damage to roads, bridges and government buildings at Rs5.69 billion.

items.title: Bodies of two Mugu men missing in avalanche found
items.blurb: The two had been missing since September 18 after setting out with a 13-member group to collect medicinal herbs near the Mugu-Humla border.
